set -e
set -u
for branch in main 2.0.x dev; do
        if [ "$branch" = "dev" -a ! -d libjpeg-turbo.$branch ]; then
                continue
        fi
        pushd libjpeg-turbo.$branch
        if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
                sh fuzz/build.sh
        else
                sh fuzz/build.sh _$branch
        fi
        popd
done
